mintAuthority.summary: syrupUSDC is Maple's ERC-4626 strategy-vault receipt for USDC lent to institutional borrowers; shares are minted against USDC deposits and do not create base USDC supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USDC (usdc-circle).

controls.label: Maple syrupUSDC ERC-4626 vault token
controls.capDescription: syrupUSDC shares are minted/burned by the Maple ERC-4626 vault against USDC deposits and FIFO-queued withdrawals; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDC supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295167: asset() returned USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x0 and admin slot = 0x0 (not upgradeable). No proxy admin or module surface detected. Wrapper share accounting only.

controls.label: Inherited USDC MasterMinter
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC supply is issuer-minted by Circle via the MasterMinter. Live masterMinter() reads resolve to this contract, which can authorize minters for the base USDC monetary supply.

controls.label: Inherited USDC token owner
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC token owner/admin can authorize USDC mint administration; syrupUSDC wrapper shares inherit this base USDC authority.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295167: syrupUSDC asset() = USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 confirmed; EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x0, admin slot = 0x0 (not upgradeable, no proxy admin surface). Wrapper is a non-upgradeable ERC-4626 vault; durable mint authority inherits from reviewed parent USDC (usdc-circle). Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Maple launched recurring The Network Firm reports on 2026-05-07, sourcing loan collateral directly from custodians and onchain activity for syrupUSDC; the current report dashboard was reviewed 2026-07-15. No exact issuer/product prudential registry entry was found.
